circularity_note: Labels are generated by a deterministic rule policy over features the model can see, so a high score measures faithful encoding of that policy, not fire-classification skill. A depth-3 decision tree and logistic regression reach comparable scores on the same split; see ml/validate.py.
interpretation: These figures measure how well the model reproduces the weak-supervision labelling policy on held-out detections. They are NOT verified real-world fire-classification accuracy, because no per-detection ground truth was available.
